svg.title: Serenity UAV build guide 09 - CARGO DOORS, LATCH, DOOR GATEWAY
svg.metadata: SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-SA-4.0. Generated by tools/gen_build_guide_cards.py; edit the CARDS table, not this file.
svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
Lapped clamshell doors, one bell-crank latch
Hang both doors on the hinge retention; they lap at the seam.
Fit each bell-crank on its pivot pin in its fixed bracket; the port crank carries the latch
Fit the door horns and pushrods.
Mount the door and release servos on their brackets; wire them to the door gateway.
Check that the hook drops into its fixed mortise with the doors closed.
The servos are bus-networked through their own gateway, not driven from a local H-bridge.
